## ✨ What You're Getting

### The Depth Effect

```
Far Background (z:0)
    ↓
    ┌─ Barely visible (opacity: 0.06)
    ┌─ Heavy blur (2px)
    ┌─ Slowest animation (48-50s)
    └─ 2 shapes: Compass, Queen

Mid Background (z:1)
    ↓
    ┌─ Soft presence (opacity: 0.12)
    ┌─ Medium blur (1px)
    ┌─ Medium animation (42-44s)
    └─ 2 shapes: Atom, Telescope

Foreground (z:2)
    ↓
    ┌─ Most visible (opacity: 0.18-0.22)
    ┌─ Minimal blur (0.5px)
    ┌─ Fastest animation (32-40s)
    └─ 4 shapes: All four types

Content (z:3)
    ↓
    └─ Always on top (Title, CTAs)
```

### The Magic Layering

Some shapes appear **behind** your badge and stats (both at z-index: 2) while others remain in front, creating a sophisticated depth illusion where UI elements weave through the constellation.

---

## 🎨 Key Features

- ✅ **8 Total Shapes** (4 front + 2 mid + 2 far)
- ✅ **3 Distinct Depth Layers** with clear visual hierarchy
- ✅ **Behind-UI Layering** (shapes appear behind some elements)
- ✅ **Constellation Aesthetic** (distant stars to foreground)
- ✅ **Balanced Colors** (50% coral, 50% teal)
- ✅ **Performance Optimized** (GPU-accelerated animations)
- ✅ **Fully Responsive** (desktop + mobile)
- ✅ **Accessible** (respects reduced motion)

## 📊 Technical Specs at a Glance

| Metric | Range | Purpose |
|--------|-------|---------|
| **Shapes** | 8 total | Creates constellation without clutter |
| **Layers** | 3 depth levels | Clear visual hierarchy |
| **Opacity** | 0.06 → 0.22 | 367% variation for depth perception |
| **Size** | 26px → 88px | 338% variation for distance cues |
| **Animation** | 32s → 50s | Faster = closer visual cue |
| **Blur** | 0.5px → 2px | Out-of-focus = further away |
| **Z-Index** | 0 → 3 | 4 stacking levels |

## 🛠️ Support & Troubleshooting

### Common Questions

**Q: Why 8 shapes instead of 4?**  
A: To create depth perception. The duplicates at different layers create the illusion of distance.

**Q: Will this slow down my site?**  
A: No. All animations use GPU-accelerated transforms. Performance tested on low-end devices.

**Q: Can I add more shapes?**  
A: Yes! Follow the customization section in depth-system-guide.md. Keep total under 12 for best results.

**Q: Some shapes appear behind my UI elements?**  
A: That's intentional! It's the "behind-UI layering" effect. Badge and stats sit at z-index: 2, same as front shapes.

**Q: Can I use different shapes?**  
A: Absolutely! Just replace the image sources. Keep class structure the same.

### Troubleshooting

| Issue | Solution |
|-------|----------|
| Shapes not visible | Check image paths, verify opacity values |
| No depth effect | Verify class names (depth-far/mid/front) |
| Animations not smooth | Check browser, clear cache, test on real device |
| Shapes block content | Adjust positions in CSS, see quick reference |

Full troubleshooting in IMPLEMENTATION-CHECKLIST.md
